supporting_observations.claim: WS-KNGUYEN-01 made repeated connections to 10.52.20.30:8080 during the review window. The observed connections include 13:35:57, 13:41:46, 13:46:43, 13:51:22, 13:57:00, 14:01:38, 14:06:50, 14:09:11, and 14:13:46 UTC.

The repeated connections are broadly consistent with the inventory's description of RouteWise checking for updates about every five minutes, but the available records do not identify RouteWise or its update domain as the source or destination.

The proxy-flow records show connections to the internal proxy on port 8080, but do not include a destination hostname, URL, TLS details, or process attribution that would establish what service generated the alerted traffic.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided network records identify the internal proxy endpoint and connection byte counts, but not the external destination or request contents (for example, T106-00030 and T106-00204).
No supplied record attributes the proxy connections to an endpoint process, so the evidence cannot connect them to RouteWise or another application.
claims_not_established: Whether the repeated connections were to update.routewise.com or another destination.
Whether the traffic was generated by approved RouteWise software, an unauthorized application, or another process.
Whether the connection contents or destination were malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-COP-01 logs for the cited times, including requested hostnames, URLs, methods, response codes, and TLS or certificate metadata if available.
Endpoint process and network telemetry from WS-KNGUYEN-01 for the cited connections, including executable path, signature, command line, and process-to-socket attribution.
DNS and endpoint/browser or updater logs that can link the connections to RouteWise and update.routewise.com.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: records show paul.becker Kerberos activity sourced from WS-KNGUYEN-01's IP, followed by network logons to WS-PBECKER-01 attributed to that same source. This is unusual against the stated remote-administration practice, but the supplied records do not establish its relation to the alerted proxy connections. Records: T106-00091, T106-00092, T106-00094, T106-00109, T106-00110, T106-00112.
